title: Police Officer Rear-ended During Traffic Stop
description:
This is why it's very important to pay special attention to emergency vehicles ahead. 

On July 13, 2021, a crash between a Lincoln SUV and a Mount Pleasant Police Department squad car sent both drivers to the hospital in Mount Pleasant, WI. The officer was sitting in the squad car, entering information into the vehicle’s computer when he was suddenly rear-ended by a Lincoln, driven by a 55-year-old woman.

Both the officer and the woman were sent to the hospital sustaining minor injuries. However, there was significant damage to both vehicles.
